narrative.intro: Fluor Marine Propulsion obligated $4.3B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Fluor Marine Propulsion received 2 awards so far this fiscal year, giving an average award size of $2.1B and obligations that are up 19.9% year over year. Fluor Marine Propulsion shows a rising pattern from FY21 through FY26: FY21 obligations were $3.1B, FY22 obligations were $3.6B, FY23 obligations were $3.5B, FY24 obligations were $3.5B, FY25 obligations were $3.6B, and FY26 obligations are $4.3B. Fluor Marine Propulsion’s top buying agencies in FY2026 to date are the Department of Defense, which obligated $2.3B, and the Department of Energy, which obligated $1.9B. Fluor Marine Propulsion’s current-year totals are partial because the figures are fiscal year to date. This summary focuses on obligations and award counts for government contractors evaluating competitor presence and agency concentration.
